find: A distinctive feature is that the rock sequence is repeated on either side of the fault — looking across the fault, each rock unit appears to continue but at a lower level on the downthrown side.
replace: A distinctive feature is that younger rocks are exposed on the downthrown side of the fault and older rocks on the upthrown side, because the fault cuts part of the succession out. A sequence that is repeated points to a reverse or thrust fault, not a normal one.
note: F4: repetition of strata is diagnostic of reverse and thrust faults; normal faults cut section out.
